summary.title: Categories - Jakub Dziworski's blog
summary.one_liner: This page is a blog archive index listing posts, including a 20-part series on building a JVM language called Enkel.
keywords: build a programming language on the jvm
takeaways: The page is an archive index of blog posts, not a tutorial itself; it lists post titles and dates only.
The largest series is 'Creating JVM language', 20 parts from March to May 2016, building a language called Enkel.
Other listed topics include ANTLR 4 listener vs visitor, JShell, JUnit vs Spock, SOLID principles, and Scala/Akka.
summary.summary: This is the categories archive page of Jakub Dziworski's Jekyll blog, listing post titles and dates from 2016 to 2022. The main series is 'Creating JVM language', 20 parts covering the Enkel language, from minimum theory and parsing through methods, conditionals, loops, constructors and fields. Other posts cover ANTLR 4 listener vs visitor, JShell, JUnit vs Spock, SOLID principles, Scala and Akka Streams, a Github code search note, and an Arduino OBD project. The page contains only titles and dates, so the actual content must be read in the individual posts.
